title: alsine bracteata
intro: Alsine bracteata, commonly known as Alsine, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the pink purslane family (Montia). It is used in traditional medicine due to its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Alsine bracteata include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of Alsine bracteata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
